verdicts.observation: world-artifacts.lua:742: 'pitch black' means extremely dark (漆黑), but the target renders it as 黑曜石 (obsidian). That adds a material the source does not state. The same file separately uses 'obsidian ring' at :715 for The Black Ring, so this translation mixes up two different unidentified names. Suggest 漆黑胸甲.

demon.lua:342: 'Although no less aggressive than their younger counterparts' means titans are just as aggressive as the younger wretchlings. The target 不比酸液树魔杀伤力小 turns aggression into damage output, which changes the meaning, and it also drops 'younger counterparts'. Also, 'few Eyalites would stand and fight' is about Eyalites not being willing to fight; 几乎无人能站在他们面前肉搏 turns that into not being able to, and drops 'Eyalites'.

timed_effects.lua:51-52: this is the on_lose message for Demon Blade. The source subject is the weapon ('#Target#'s weapon looks less threatening'), matching :51 where the effect puts demonic fire on the weapon. The target #Target#的危险度看起来降低了 drops 'weapon' and says the character looks less dangerous, which misstates where the effect was. Suggest #Target#的武器看起来没那么危险了.

unlock-corrupter_demonologist.lua:21-35 has four problems. (1) Line 22 'have created many dark cults' is translated as 通过黑暗仪式 (dark rituals): cults are not rituals, and the act of founding them is lost. (2) Lines 21-23 are separated by single newlines in the source, but the target adds a blank line after 双面间谍。 and after 恐慌。, which breaks the newline invariant. (3) The same text renders demonic seeds as both 恶魔之种 and 恶魔种子. (4) Corruptors is rendered as both 堕落系 and 堕落者, so terms are inconsistent within this one entry.
